title: Vienna vs Prague: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Prague for fairy-tale medieval beauty and budget travel. Vienna for world-class museums, coffee house culture, and Imperial grandeur. Do both — the train takes under 4 hours.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Prague €60–80/day vs Vienna €90–130/day — Prague is 30-40% cheaper across the board.

categories.name: Museums
categories.summary: Vienna has Kunsthistorisches, Belvedere (Klimt), and Albertina. Prague is solid but in a different league.

categories.name: City Aesthetics
categories.summary: Prague's intact medieval center is among Europe's most photogenic. Vienna's Ringstrasse is grander but more spread out.

categories.name: Coffee Culture
categories.summary: UNESCO-listed Viennese Kaffeehaus tradition is unique in the world. Prague has excellent cafés but no equivalent.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Prague wins on value and volume. Czech lager at €2/pint, lively Žižkov and Vinohrady bar scenes.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Both offer excellent Central European cuisine. Vienna has Wiener Schnitzel and international variety; Prague wins on value.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Both have excellent transit. Prague's core is more compact; Vienna's U-Bahn covers a larger city well.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Vienna: Budapest, Salzburg, Bratislava, Hallstatt. Prague: Kutná Hora, Český Krumlov, Karlovy Vary.

categories.name: Christmas Markets
categories.summary: Vienna's Rathausplatz market is among Europe's best. Prague's Old Town Square is magical but smaller.

categories.name: English Spoken
categories.summary: Both good in tourist areas; Vienna is more consistent outside the center.

faq.question: Is Vienna or Prague better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Prague for visual drama and budget; Vienna for cultural depth and museums.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Vienna or Prague?
faq.answer: Prague is 30-40% cheaper — €60-80/day vs €90-130/day in Vienna.

faq.question: How many days do you need?
Can you visit both on one trip?
